chunk_summary: Chunk 1/7 (20 commits, all in both the engine and server lines). 12 of them are already in v0.1.45/v0.2.12 as upstream ports under the same subject and author havok2-htwo. 8 of those 12 have the same patch-id: ee2a907e, dd544364, b82cdb10, 20f75a74, 0f10feb4, a5ad4077, c2b44ca5, 6ab4c312. The other 4 differ only slightly: 86f677b4 (one comment), 574dcbf9 (doc wording), 02d0c23a (upstream added an A4000 paragraph) and 7d9b50dc. 7d9b50dc (our 7cdd921f, STRATA_MMQ_DIRECT) DROPPED our NVFP4 guard `if (f.tail_off) continue;`: v0.2.12 prefill.cpp:1595 marks a layer direct with no tail_off check. Production runs IQ4_XS, so it is unaffected, but this one-line fix is worth sending upstream. Production-relevant switches already upstream: >8 slots on a split (parallel 16), STRATA_SLOT_COPY_DIRECT (also in v0.2.12 PARALLEL_STACK_ENV by default), STRATA_MMQ_DIRECT + the -DSTRATA_MMQ_TAB build option. MERGE NOTE: v0.2.12 CMake turns STRATA_MMQ_TAB off when the mmq.cuh hash differs from the mirrored scheduler, so the merged prod build must use -DSTRATA_MMQ_TAB=ON and check the cmake log. Our tools/batch_test16/32.py were folded into tools/batch_test.py (db568409). The STRATA_PIPE_OVERLAP series (020ed391, c7e8fe1e, 377f1b33, 74a3b4f2, c6939188, 90909f7c) is NOT upstream and IS on in production (STRATA_PIPE_OVERLAP=1, with _KVS from a later chunk). Upstream's alternative is STRATA_PIPED_CONCURRENT (#2326) plus STRATA_PIPED_READ_PIECE/PIECE (#2050). In v0.2.12, concurrent_read_off() (include/strata/program/batch_read.hpp) still turns PIPED_CONCURRENT off beside STRATA_SPLIT_MTP_BATCH (=1 in production) and beside staged-blob expert sources. TESTLOG #90 measured it never engaging on our config. PIECE=16384 cut a stream's stop only to 4.5 s, while our overlap cut the join pause to 0.27-0.35 s (#80/#81). Upstream has no PLE concurrency setters (set_concurrent, urgent tickets, read-slot reserve). The series therefore needs a hard port: generate.cpp grew from 14.2k to 21.5k lines, and read_part was reworked around PIPED_CONCURRENT and pieces. A merge-tree run of 020ed391^..7fcea102 onto v0.2.12 conflicts in verify.hpp/.cpp, mtp.hpp/.cpp, ngram.hpp/.cpp, ple_reader.cpp (cuda and sycl), prefill.hpp/.cpp, generate.cpp and server.py. STRATA_PIPE_OVERLAP_MAX_QUEUE (56690405) and the server's waiting=N (7fcea102) are not in production and were measured with no effect (TESTLOG #43): drop.

Nine have the same patch-id as ours (a2d979b9, a923889b, 62fc7c8a, bec9edf1, f32663a8, 2f4fe20a, a71ee46c, 6959adf4, and 0cf1a9b7/139d702e/ca239cda/1d9758f8, whose +/- lines match exactly). Since v0.2.9, upstream's PARALLEL_STACK_ENV in serve/server.py and src/core/arch_defaults.cpp turns on CKPT_POOL(+_READY=4), SLOT_CKPT_MOVE, SLOT_COPY_DIRECT, SLOT_COPY_BATCHSYNC, BATCH_SELF_COMMIT and QSA_SLOTS by default. Our prod env still sets these switches explicitly, but STRATA_BYIELD_NODRAIN, ADMIT_MERGE_FIRST, CKPT_THREADS, MMQ_GROUP_SORT and HANDOFF_PIPE=8 stay opt-in upstream and must stay in our env. (2) 9e64a578, STRATA_SLOT_PARK: upstream's alternative is #2526 park_slot (01e404c1, a synchronous park before an admission overwrites the slot). It returns early with --mtp and without --batch-mtp, which is exactly our prod config, and it does not cover pad-row wipes under pipelined groups. So ours (+2.6-2.9 % multi-turn, TESTLOG #70) is still needed. Moderate: conversation_tier.cpp/.hpp/_test are new files; 8 conflict hunks in CMakeLists, DETAILS.md, conversation_cache.hpp and generate.cpp. (4) 4341ea6f, server /metrics tier: merges cleanly onto v0.2.12 server.py (ConvCacheLog is still there). chunk_summary:
Chunk 3/7 (20 commits). Already upstream: ADMIT_SHORT_FIRST (0b8a82f8 = ed4fa42a in v0.1.45), the HC_Q8 trimmed-split fix (aa8c85d7 ~ abf2953b; not used in prod) and GR_NORM_FAST on CUDA (bfca9a6a ~ fec7d1ca; prod must keep setting it, since sm_86 nv_defaults do not include it).

The main porting work is the vision series. v0.2.12 still has one M-RoPE table per device and sends BGENI into batch slots, so upstream's batch-plus-vision corruption bug is still there. Our guard 674fbe41 (moderate), image gate 1b9247b1 (hard; server.py grew from 6976 to 10535 lines with a new admission/coalesce structure) and per-slot regions 77e9b9e1+12242dcb (hard; every new staging/position writer in the reworked verify.cpp/mtp.cpp needs the region base; prod uses MROPE_SLOTS=1) all need porting. They are strong upstream PR candidates.

Cache work that needs porting and is active in prod: STRATA_SLOT_CHAIN_REUSE/GIVEBACK_CHECKS (d9927ecf, hard, depends on the unported SLOT_PARK 9e64a578), the SLOT_PARK pool fix 12f2715d (trivial once SLOT_PARK exists; also clear upstream's new dev_tag) and STRATA_MSG_CKPT_TAIL (7f86f97c, moderate; upstream's --prompt-cache-tail is single-GPU only and a different cut, so it does not replace ours on the layer split).

Server items that need porting: GET /v1/load (44d8ff4b, 3850a79e, moderate; watch the clash with upstream POST /load and /v1/load = model load), STRATA_PREFIX_DIAG (bba60a17, moderate, self-contained module) and the image diag log (1ce30723, trivial). The test race fix f17f3eec still applies cleanly to upstream and is worth a small PR. STRATA_IMAGE_HISTORY (db073efd, 6a379e65) is opt-in, unset in prod and made unnecessary by per-slot regions, so drop it. Tools and docs (f8a41fff, bbf90765, f2ef22b3) go with their features. Temporary index for the apply checks: /tmp/claude-1000/-media-raid0-StrataQ38FN/07837ea6-13aa-4738-916e-a62b73a0cbb0/scratchpad/inv/idx3, idx3b.

Chunk 4/7 is the 2026-10-16 round of low-level levers (TESTLOG #77/#78). v0.2.12 has none of these switches: STRATA_GR_DOWN_PF, EARLY_SAMPLE, ATTN_VBATCH, QSA_SLOTS_STREAM, GR_DOWN_SPLIT, GR_UP_SPLIT, ROUTE_PLAN_FUSE and SPLIT_OWN_RESERVE_MIB all return 0 hits on git grep and git log -S. The only STRATA_GR_DOWN_SPLIT hit is an unrelated compile-time macro in sycl/fused_gr.dp.cpp.

Four of these switches are in production and must be ported: QSA_SLOTS_STREAM=1 (trivial), ATTN_VBATCH=1 (moderate to hard, 8 conflict regions in qsa_decode_attn.cu), GR_DOWN_PF=2 (moderate, textual conflict with upstream's down_tg branch) and EARLY_SAMPLE=1 (moderate, sample_rows was reworked around slot_row_draw for slot penalties and logit bias).

Two of them overlap with what upstream ships. VBATCH overlaps with STRATA_ATTN_DAILY, which uses PR #540's kernel, is bit-exact, and is on by default in v0.2.12 for sm_86 through nv_defaults.cpp. On 4x3090, apply_nv_defaults in generate.cpp then sets DAILY=1 at startup. That makes pre75_attn() true, which has two effects: (a) our VBATCH kernels never run (pre75 takes precedence in our patch), and (b) qsa_decode_attn_slots() returns false, so our production STRATA_QSA_SLOTS, and with it QSA_SLOTS_STREAM, silently falls back to per-row launches. The port must decide this, either STRATA_ATTN_DAILY=0 in production.json or STRATA_SM86_PERF=0, or teach the slots kernel the DAILY body. Tonight's A/B needs these arms: DAILY vs VBATCH+QSA_SLOTS(_STREAM). GR_DOWN_PF overlaps with upstream's HC read v3 (STRATA_GR_V3 / GR_V3_PF), which uses a different summation order, is not bitwise, and is on by default only on sm_120.

EARLY_SAMPLE has never been measured on its own. The HTTP A/B was greedy, so only the LL-all arm included it.

Drop: GR_DOWN_SPLIT (measured slower), GR_UP_SPLIT and ROUTE_PLAN_FUSE (exact but within noise, already marked dropped in the memory backlog), with their stubs and tests. In 3af0006d the DOWN_SPLIT code is woven into the PF kernel (ROWS template), so PF should be ported in its 6d513178+096efada form, without the split.

SPLIT_OWN_RESERVE_MIB merges cleanly and is not in production. It is the enabler for the measured loan-free 11,24,37 rebalance (s28r, +4.9 % short / +3.6 % long HTTP, never deployed), so carry it.

chunk_summary: Chunk 5/7 (20 commits) splits into four features. (1) The HC-read down/up split follow-ups (194f94ac, bbe587e5, adc906cf) are opt-in STRATA_GR_DOWN_SPLIT/UP_SPLIT. TESTLOG #78 measured them as not adopted (down split slower, up split within noise). They are not in production, and v0.2.12 has neither switch on CUDA, only an unrelated SYCL #define. Upstream also rewrote fused_gr.cu (HC read v3, per-device smem opt-in ee108afe). Verdict: drop, together with their base commits 0bf42041/56ab8db2/95a33b1f/56342093. (2) STRATA_PIPE_OVERLAP_KVS (15ccf028, aff75ebb plus tests 5fb49a53, df7f0409) is in production. It extends our STRATA_PIPE_OVERLAP, which is absent in v0.2.12 (grep finds no hit, only PIPE_BYIELD_NODRAIN made it). Upstream's alternatives STRATA_PIPED_CONCURRENT and PIPED_READ_PIECE never engaged in our config (TESTLOG #90: PIPED_CONCURRENT turns itself off beside staged expert sources and SPLIT_MTP_BATCH). Our overlap measured join pauses of 7.7 s -> 0.35 s and 19.3 s -> 0.29 s (TESTLOG #81). Needs port after the PIPE_OVERLAP base. (3) Solo pipeline plus spec lanes (81015495, 0238f7f8, 7db06746, 1edbfdb9, ee403737, 25221fc9, a069ac58, abdc40fb, ba107591, f60f4ea5) is all in production (STRATA_SPEC_LANES=4, STRATA_SOLO_PIPELINE=1). Upstream v0.2.10+ has STRATA_PW_WITH_BATCH (d17c52e7, port of PR 3095 by Vop3p). It is a 28-line alternative to our solo pipeline that only lifts the gate: no pl-mode graphs, no VRAM pre-check. Upstream STRATA_PIPED_MTP (#4121) is a different mechanism for drafting with 2-4 users: MTP drafts inside the pipelined groups, needs --batch-mtp and windows of at most 8 rows, measured +16 %/+10 % at 2/4 streams on 2x A6000. It was never measured on our box. Ours measured +45 % at 2 users and +38 %/+26 % at 3/4 users (TESTLOG #82/#84). No lane or arena code is upstream, so this needs a port. It is hard: generate.cpp grew from 14.2K to 21.5K lines and verify.cpp by about 2.4K changed lines, although Verifier still carves arena_ and has set_always_publish. (4) Fair reads: engine STRATA_READ_YIELD (45073129, 6c9607f5) and server STRATA_YIELD_SHORT (5549a72b) are both in production. Upstream keeps only the #656 BYIELD rule (a prompt under half the running one's length; YIELDS_MAX fixed at 2) and has no should_yield, YIELDNO, yield_row, top-row slot or new-token rule. Needs port. The engine part is hard, because the read paths were reorganized upstream (batch_read.hpp pieces, layer-major walk, PIPED_CONCURRENT thread). The server part is moderate (server.py is heavily churned, but _shorter_waiting, give_way/ask and pick_slot still exist).
